# Extended regexes (case-insensitive) matched against every shell command the agent runs.
# One per line. Lines starting with # are comments. A match = the command is denied.
# Tune per project; agents cannot edit this file (it is in deny-paths.txt).

# --- Destructive filesystem ---
\brm\s+(-[a-z]*\s+)*(/|~|\$HOME|/\*|\.\.)(\s|$)
\bmkfs\b
\bdd\s+if=.*of=/dev/
:\(\)\s*\{\s*:\|:&\s*\};:

# --- Privilege escalation / host changes ---
\bsudo\b
\bsu\s+-?\s*$
\bchmod\s+(-R\s+)?777\b
\bdocker\s+run\b.*--privileged

# --- Remote code execution patterns ---
\b(curl|wget)\b[^|]*\|\s*(sudo\s+)?(ba|z|)sh\b
\bbash\s+<\(\s*(curl|wget)

# --- Git history safety (repo-type rules are appended at the end of this file) ---
\bgit\s+(filter-branch|filter-repo)\b
\bgit\s+config\s+(--global|--system)\b

# --- Human-only steps: drafting and creating issues / tasks ---
\b(new-draft|create-issues?|create-tasks?)\.(sh|ps1)\b

# --- Cloud / infra changes (agents never deploy) ---
\bterraform\s+(apply|destroy|import|state)\b
\b(cdk|npx\s+cdk)\s+(deploy|destroy|bootstrap)\b
\bpulumi\s+(up|destroy)\b
\bsam\s+deploy\b
\baws\s+\S+\s+(delete|terminate|remove|put|create|update|attach|detach|modify|deregister)-
\bkubectl\s+(delete|apply|replace|scale|drain)\b
\bhelm\s+(install|upgrade|uninstall|delete)\b

# --- Secret access ---
\b(cat|less|more|head|tail|bat|nl|strings|xxd|grep|awk|sed|cp|scp)\b[^|;&]*(\.env(\.|\s|$)|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.ssh/|\.aws/credentials|\.npmrc|\.pypirc|\.netrc|\.git-credentials)
^\s*(env|printenv|set)\s*$
\bprintenv\b.*(TOKEN|SECRET|KEY|PASSWORD)
\becho\s+.*\$\{?[A-Z_]*(TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|API_KEY)

# --- Audit log tampering ---
(\brm\b|\bmv\b|\btruncate\b|\bshred\b|sed\s+-i|>\s*)[^|;&]*\.agent-logs
